entry.title: Market brief — 17 November 2026 close
entry.summary: Indian market brief in plain English: on Tuesday 17 November 2026 the Nifty 50 closed at 25,387.40 (+96.30, +0.38%) and the Sensex at 82,532.19 (+427.40, +0.52%), both at their highest since late February, with the rupee 43 paise stronger at 93.51 per dollar (Reuters put the close at 93.47). IBJA's 12:00 IST benchmark put 24K gold at Rs 1,34,418 per 10 g (-553) and 999 silver at Rs 1,68,950 per kg (-1,301). The next session is Wednesday 18 November 2026.
